answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in orchard and vine lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the cipher graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1840 impostors cost 1764 times the honest price and take 19 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
